entities.name: Query kynureninase
observations: A 365-residue protein sequence is homologous to reviewed kynureninases Q1DDU5, Q1DZA6, and B0RUZ9 at 43.0–45.1% identity with 96.4–97.8% query coverage.
The sequence contains an Aminotran_5 domain at residues 92–264 and KYNU_C matches at residues 246–291 and 316–358.

The inferred enzyme is pyridoxal 5'-phosphate dependent and belongs to the kynureninase family; exact substrate preference remains inferred from homology rather than directly demonstrated for this sequence.

source_tools.relevance: Sequence properties, homologs, catalytic annotations, and Pfam domains

entities.name: L-kynurenine cleavage
observations: Kynureninase reaction: L-kynurenine + H2O → anthranilate + L-alanine + H(+). Rhea RHEA:16813; EC 3.7.1.3 in reviewed homolog annotations.
The reaction is a PLP-dependent beta-elimination/cleavage of kynurenine yielding anthranilate and alanine.

source_tools.relevance: Curated reaction annotations from multiple reviewed kynureninase homologs

entities.name: 3-hydroxykynurenine cleavage
observations: Alternative kynureninase reaction: 3-hydroxy-L-kynurenine + H2O → 3-hydroxyanthranilate + L-alanine + H(+). Rhea RHEA:25143 in reviewed homolog annotations.
Whether the query protein efficiently accepts 3-hydroxy-L-kynurenine is inferred from family homology and is not directly measured here.

observations: Reviewed kynureninase homologs are annotated as requiring pyridoxal 5'-phosphate (PLP; ChEBI:CHEBI:597326).
